title: Slurm GRES：GPU、CPU 與記憶體的整數裝箱
titleEn: Slurm GRES: integer packing of GPUs, CPUs and memory
subcategoryTitle: 排程與可重現軟體堆疊
summary: 以合成資料重建「Slurm GRES：GPU、CPU 與記憶體的整數裝箱」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付資源向量、每種限制商數與記憶體高水位證據。
summaryEn: Reconstruct Slurm GRES: integer packing of GPUs, CPUs and memory with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver resource vectors, quotient limits and memory high-water evidence.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.questionEn: Resource-vector table: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 空 GPU 不代表其他資源足夠；若 CPU 綁定遠離 GPU，效能也可能差，需另檢查 affinity。
不可為提高裝箱率而低報記憶體；實測高水位與餘裕應先通過。
Slurm GRES 表達 GPU 等資源；本課以整數資源限制分析「有空 GPU 仍排不進」的原因。
optionsEn: An idle GPU does not imply other resources suffice; remote CPU/GPU affinity can also reduce performance.
Do not underrequest memory to improve packing; observed high-water marks and headroom must pass first.
Slurm GRES represents GPUs and other resources; integer constraints explain why idle GPUs may not admit another job.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Slurm GRES represents GPUs and other resources; integer constraints explain why idle GPUs may not admit another job. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Units match in each column and GPU requests are integers.

options: 三工作用 240 GiB 留 16；第四個需再 80，名義不可行；變更四個剛好 256。
空 GPU 不代表其他資源足夠；若 CPU 綁定遠離 GPU，效能也可能差，需另檢查 affinity。

optionsEn: Three jobs use 240 GiB leaving 16; a fourth needs 80 and cannot fit; four changed jobs use exactly 256.

Node: 64 CPUs, 4 GPUs, 256 GiB; each job: 8 CPUs, 1 GPU, 80 GiB, changed to 64 GiB.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「獨立驗證方法」。三工作用 240 GiB 留 16；第四個需再 80，名義不可行；變更四個剛好 256。 與本階段判準一起判讀：每欄單位一致且請求是整數 GPU。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies independent verification. Three jobs use 240 GiB leaving 16; a fourth needs 80 and cannot fit; four changed jobs use exactly 256. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Units match in each column and GPU requests are integers.

steps.instruction:
三工作用 240 GiB 留 16；第四個需再 80，名義不可行；變更四個剛好 256。
回到本階段實驗：將 CPU、GPU、GiB 分三欄，分開實體資源與工作請求；不混用 MB/GiB。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：每欄單位一致且請求是整數 GPU。
steps.instructionEn:
Three jobs use 240 GiB leaving 16; a fourth needs 80 and cannot fit; four changed jobs use exactly 256.
Return to the investigation: Use separate CPU, GPU and GiB columns for physical resources and job requests; do not mix MB and GiB.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: Units match in each column and GPU requests are integers.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。三工作用 240 GiB 留 16；第四個需再 80，名義不可行；變更四個剛好 256。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Three jobs use 240 GiB leaving 16; a fourth needs 80 and cannot fit; four changed jobs use exactly 256.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 每欄單位一致且請求是整數 GPU。
steps.checkEn: Units match in each column and GPU requests are integers.

quiz.question: 「資源向量表」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Resource-vector table: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 名義式 min(floor(64/8),min(floor(4/1),floor(256/80))) = 3 jobs/node；變更式 min(floor(64/8),min(floor(4/1),floor(256/64))) = 4 jobs/node。只把每工作記憶體需求由 80 改為經驗證的 64 GiB。 全部負載、量測和門檻是原創教學假設，不是產品規格。

空 GPU 不代表其他資源足夠；若 CPU 綁定遠離 GPU，效能也可能差，需另檢查 affinity。
optionsEn: Nominal: min(floor(64/8),min(floor(4/1),floor(256/80))) = 3 jobs/node; changed: min(floor(64/8),min(floor(4/1),floor(256/64))) = 4 jobs/node. Change only per-job memory from 80 to a verified 64 GiB. All workload measurements and thresholds are original teaching assumptions, not product specifications.
Deliver resource vectors, quotient limits and memory high-water evidence.
An idle GPU does not imply other resources suffice; remote CPU/GPU affinity can also reduce performance.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。空 GPU 不代表其他資源足夠；若 CPU 綁定遠離 GPU，效能也可能差，需另檢查 affinity。 與本階段判準一起判讀：每欄單位一致且請求是整數 GPU。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. An idle GPU does not imply other resources suffice; remote CPU/GPU affinity can also reduce performance. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Units match in each column and GPU requests are integers.

steps.title: 資源向量表 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Resource-vector table · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「資源向量表」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Resource-vector table and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
空 GPU 不代表其他資源足夠；若 CPU 綁定遠離 GPU，效能也可能差，需另檢查 affinity。
對照「資源向量表」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。不可為提高裝箱率而低報記憶體；實測高水位與餘裕應先通過。
本階段必須重驗：每欄單位一致且請求是整數 GPU。
steps.instructionEn:
An idle GPU does not imply other resources suffice; remote CPU/GPU affinity can also reduce performance.
Against the nominal Resource-vector table result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Do not underrequest memory to improve packing; observed high-water marks and headroom must pass first.
Reverify this criterion: Units match in each column and GPU requests are integers.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。空 GPU 不代表其他資源足夠；若 CPU 綁定遠離 GPU，效能也可能差，需另檢查 affinity。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. An idle GPU does not imply other resources suffice; remote CPU/GPU affinity can also reduce performance.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 每欄單位一致且請求是整數 GPU。
steps.checkEn: Units match in each column and GPU requests are integers.

steps.objective: 完成「資源向量表」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。

steps.instruction:
交付資源向量、每種限制商數與記憶體高水位證據。
在交接件中加入「資源向量表」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：每欄單位一致且請求是整數 GPU。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以合成資料重建「Slurm GRES：GPU、CPU 與記憶體的整數裝箱」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付資源向量、每種限制商數與記憶體高水位證據。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver resource vectors, quotient limits and memory high-water evidence.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Resource-vector table: Units match in each column and GPU requests are integers.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Reconstruct Slurm GRES: integer packing of GPUs, CPUs and memory with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver resource vectors, quotient limits and memory high-water evidence. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。每欄單位一致且請求是整數 GPU。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Units match in each column and GPU requests are integers.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
